Use copper-auburn waist-length stage hair, a small tilted navy sailor cap, broad navy-and-white sailor collar, sky-blue bow, original silver heart ornament, structured dark-denim pinafore and compact navy ankle boots. One centered head-to-toe human with no scenery, props, text, logo, shadow or detached effects.
